question: Which city in central India became the first to provide CAR T-cell therapy for blood cancer patients, marking a significant advancement in accessible cancer treatment in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Nagpur became the first city in central India to offer CAR T-cell therapy for blood cancer patients in May 2025.
 
• CAR T-cell therapy is a revolutionary treatment that involves reprogramming a patient's immune cells to attack cancer cells effectively.
 
• This therapy was made accessible in Nagpur at a lower cost compared to international standards, ensuring greater affordability for Indian patients.
 
• The treatment was introduced at a leading medical facility in Nagpur, reflecting the city's growing prominence in healthcare advancements.
 
• It marked a milestone in India's fight against cancer by bringing cutting-edge treatments closer to patients in central India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **CAR T-Cell Therapy**:

 
 
• CAR T-cell therapy stands for Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-cell therapy, a form of immunotherapy designed to combat blood cancers like leukemia and lymphoma.
 
• It involves modifying T-cells, a type of white blood cell, in the laboratory to enable them to identify and kill cancer cells.
 
• This therapy has shown promising results globally but remains expensive and is primarily available in specialized centers.
 
• By making this treatment accessible in Nagpur, India has taken a significant step toward democratizing advanced cancer care.
